dct_description_sm:
Discover Barrie GeoHub Site is a centralized starting point to access all spatial and related information about the City of Barrie. From here navigate yourself around the City of Barrie through interactive web mapping applications, view static maps of the City, download and leverage GIS data in the Open Data page and use City information in our own applications by downloading it through connecting in the Web Services page, 

The City of Barrie is situated in the heart of Central Ontario, a premier waterfront community on Lake Simcoe, conveniently located an hour north of Toronto.  Visit barrie.ca for more information or contact Service Barrie at 705-726-4242 or ServiceBarrie@barrie.ca
